Panorama Kata Ocean View Villas

Вилла — Карон (рядом с Катой)
ГлавнаяПродажаPanorama Kata Ocean View Villas

Developer marketing renders (artist impressions). Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

О проекте

Panorama Kata Ocean View Villas is a hillside development of two and three-bedroom villas with ocean views above Kata and Karon on Phuket's south-west coast. FazWaz lists 17 units (another portal 21) with two-bedroom villas of about 138 to 160 sqm and three-bedroom villas of about 213 to 239 sqm; completion is listed as March 2027 although other sources give different dates.

Facilities listed are a communal garden, parking, 24-hour security and CCTV; pets are not allowed. The portal payment schedule starts with a THB 150,000 reservation and 35% on contract signing within 15 days, followed by construction-stage payments.

Kata Beach is about 2.9 km away, Kata Noi Beach 3.8 km and Karon Beach 4.6 km (straight line), and Wat Kitti Sangkharam is about 1.3 km. Patong Hospital is about 12.5 km and the airport about 73 minutes' drive. Prices on portals run from roughly THB 11 million to 23.9 million. The sources name different developers, so we do not state one; ask us to confirm.
